lines.en: A warm feeling (the type that could not be confused for arousal) flooded through Chika Chosokabe so quickly and so deeply that she felt as if her heart was full.
lines.zh: 一阵暖意（绝不会被误认成情欲的那种）如此迅速、如此深沉地淹没了 Chika Chosokabe，让她觉得自己的心满满的。

lines.en: It was everything she wanted (minus one mother) all in one room. Defenseless. Sleeping. Adorable.
lines.zh: 她想要的一切（只差一位母亲）都在同一个房间里。毫无防备。沉睡着。可爱极了。

lines.en: And she was filled with that sort of cute-aggression that made her want to strangle both of them until they were dead and frozen in this scene for all eternity (or until the cops come).
lines.zh: 而她心里涨满了那种「可爱到想掐死你」的冲动，想掐死他们两个，让他们就这样定格在这一幕里，直到永远（或者直到警察上门）。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch5
But she would not do this — for she was not a murderer. And she loved the two of them so dearly that even the thought of harm befalling them made her want to kill herself instead.
lines.zh: 但她不会这么做——因为她不是杀人犯。而且她那么深爱着他们两个，光是想到会有人伤害他们，她就宁愿自己去死。

lines.en: What she did not yet understand is that harm befell the man below her before he’d even reached Chinami’s age.
lines.zh: 她还不明白的是：躺在她下面那个男人，早在长到 Chinami 这个年纪之前，就已经遭遇过伤害了。

lines.en: And if he was a better student, Chika may have walked in on him perpetuating the cycle and violently fucking her little sister instead of just peacefully sleeping beside her.
lines.zh: 而如果他是个更「优秀」的学生，Chika 推门看到的也许就是他在延续这个循环、狠狠操着她妹妹，而不只是安静地睡在她身边。

lines.en: But again, this was not a thought that occurred to her — for she was a good girl. Who did good things.
lines.zh: 不过这念头也没在她脑子里出现过——因为她是个好女孩。做着好事的女孩。

lines.en: : Look at them...

lines.en: But she was blinded by love.

lines.en: Then put on her pajamas before crawling into the futon with her make-believe husband.
lines.zh: 然后换上睡衣，钻进被褥，躺到她那位「挂名丈夫」身边。

lines.en: It was a dream come true — but it was also a dream that would deprive her of sleep as she didn’t want to wake up and find that he had gone back home without saying goodbye.
lines.zh: 这简直是美梦成真——可也正是这个梦让她睡不着，因为她不想一觉醒来，发现他已经不告而别回家去了。

lines.en: So she lied there, staring up at the ceiling for at least an hour. But it felt like longer.
lines.zh: 于是她躺在那儿，盯着天花板看了至少一个小时。可感觉比那还久。

lines.en: Her gaze would linger occasionally toward her sister to see if she was still asleep. And she was. Every time.
lines.zh: 她的目光偶尔会飘向妹妹，看她是不是还睡着。而她确实还睡着。每一次都是。

lines.en: In those moments, she’d place a hand on the back of the man beside her, stroking him softly and hoping that he’d wake up and find her there.
lines.zh: 在那些时刻，她会把手搭在身边男人的背上，轻轻抚摸，盼着他能醒来、发现她就在那儿。

lines.en: But {i}he{/i} didn’t wake up either. So she was alone with her thoughts.
lines.zh: 可{i}他{/i}也没醒。于是她只能独自与自己的思绪作伴。

lines.en: And those thoughts grew impure each time she caught his warmth.
lines.zh: 而每次感受到他的体温，那些思绪就变得更不纯洁。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch14
Reckless behavior like this is common in those who spend so long tunneled in on something that they can’t even tell when they’re approaching a cliff to nothingness.
lines.zh: 这种鲁莽的行为，在那些长久地钻进某件事里、连自己正走向虚无的悬崖都察觉不到的人身上很常见。

lines.en: Which is why Chika Chosokabe assumed that the kind and seductive gesture of waking her {i}husband{/i} up with a handjob couldn’t possibly go wrong.
lines.zh: 正因如此，Chika Chosokabe 认定，用打飞机这种温柔又撩人的方式叫醒她的{i}丈夫{/i}，绝不可能出岔子。

lines.en: And if this is were the beginning of the game, she would probably be right.
lines.zh: 如果这是游戏刚开始的时候，她大概是对的。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch15
But it’s {i}not{/i} the beginning of the game anymore. And every second that goes by, someone {i}else{/i} is falling off of a cliff to nothingness.
lines.zh: 可现在{i}已经不是{/i}游戏刚开始的时候了。而每过去一秒，都有{i}别的什么人{/i}正从悬崖坠入虚无。

lines.en: Recklessness now is more reckless than ever before. And it’s this exact thing that will carry us away from here.
lines.zh: 此时的鲁莽，比以往任何时候都更鲁莽。而正是这个东西，会把我们从这里带走。

lines.en: But where will it take us I wonder?
lines.zh: 可它会把我们带去哪儿呢，我想知道。

Groggy from being torn from her sleep, Chinami Chosokabe remembered very little about her last hour before passing out.
lines.zh: 被从睡梦中硬生生拽醒，Chinami Chosokabe 昏昏沉沉的，几乎记不清自己昏睡前的最后一个小时发生了什么。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch18
It wasn’t common for her sister’s boyfriend to stay the night, so she assumed he had already gone home by now.
lines.zh: 姐姐的男朋友留宿并不常见，所以她以为他这会儿已经回家了。

lines.en: But without anywhere left to go and no one waiting for him at home, he had no issues passing out right beside her.
lines.zh: 可他无处可去，家里也没人在等他，所以他毫不在意地就在她身边睡了过去。

lines.en: So as she scanned the apartment looking for her sister, a trace of him was the last thing she expected to find.
lines.zh: 所以当她扫视公寓寻找姐姐时，他的踪迹是她最没料到会找到的东西。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch19
Which is precisely what made the following scene unfolding before her eyes all the more shocking.
lines.zh: 也正是因为这个，接下来在她眼前展开的那一幕才格外令人震惊。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch20

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch21

There they were — locked in a pose befitting animals, diving so deeply into a world of their own that they’d forgotten she exists at all.
lines.zh: 他们就在那儿——摆着一个只有野兽才会用的姿势，深深地沉进属于他们两人的世界，以至于完全忘了她的存在。

lines.en: She observed her sister's trembling legs as she hung precariously over the railing Chinami had been warned to never approach.
lines.zh: 她看着姐姐颤抖的双腿——她正岌岌可危地挂在栏杆上，而那栏杆是 Chinami 从小被警告绝不能靠近的。

lines.en: But instead of fearing for her sister’s safety, Chinami couldn’t help but think of other things. Things she {i}hadn’t{/i} been warned of.
lines.zh: 可 Chinami 没有为姐姐的安危担心，反而忍不住想到了别的事。那些{i}从来没人{/i}警告过她的事。

lines.en: Like how this pose was reminiscent of the video she’d watched earlier. And how it seemed exponentially more {i}lewd{/i} now that it involved people she knew.
lines.zh: 比如这个姿势让她想起之前看过的那段视频。而当主角换成她认识的人，它似乎就{i}淫秽{/i}了不知多少倍。

lines.en: She was angry, but she didn’t know why. She was sad, but she didn’t know why. She felt guilty, but she didn’t know {i}why.{/i} Yet she couldn’t look away.
lines.zh: 她很生气，却不知道为什么。她很难过，却不知道为什么。她感到内疚，却不知道{i}为什么{/i}。可她就是移不开视线。

lines.en: This amalgamation of negativity did not blend in with the scene unfolding before her. It only made her feel {i}worse{/i} that she could not bring herself to flee.
lines.zh: 这一团混杂的负面情绪，与眼前展开的画面格格不入。而它只是让她因为无法让自己逃离而感到{i}更糟{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
For ten minutes she watched them, standing still as a statue and hoping she’d be caught. But she wasn’t.
lines.zh: 她站在那儿像座雕塑一样看了他们十分钟，心里盼着被他们发现。可他们没有。

lines.en: And she would fetch her {i}own{/i} glass of water before taking one sip, then crawling back into her futon where she would sleep soundly until the following morning.
lines.zh: 然后她{i}自己{/i}去倒了杯水，只喝了一口，就爬回被褥，一觉睡到第二天早上。

lines.zh: 第二天早上明亮多了。还不只是{i}字面意义上{/i}的明亮。

lines.en: Chinami awoke to the scent of pancakes and the sounds of her sister cheerfully humming.
lines.zh: Chinami 在煎饼的香气和姐姐欢快的哼歌声中醒来。

lines.en: But it filled Chinami with conflicting emotions as her sister hadn’t even bothered changing her pajamas after being defiled in them on the balcony.
lines.zh: 可这让 Chinami 心里五味杂陈——姐姐穿着那身在阳台上被弄脏的睡衣，居然连换都懒得换。

lines.en: “Perhaps this is not something I should think about so negatively?” she thought, thinking negatively.
lines.zh: 「也许我不该把这件事想得这么负面？」她一边这么想，一边想得很负面。

So she approached her sister and greeted her with a merry, “Good morning” in an attempt to alleviate the new-found discomfort she was feeling.

lines.en: : Maybe Chinami will just look answers up on her phone.
lines.zh: : 那 Chinami 干脆在自己手机上查答案好了。

lines.en: : Oh, that reminds me! I read an article the other day about how our phones are tracking us and stuff, so I’ve decided that I’m going to get rid of {i}both{/i} of ours! Hope you don’t mind!
lines.zh: : 哦，这倒提醒我了!我前几天看了篇文章，说我们的手机在追踪我们什么的，所以我决定把{i}我们俩的{/i}手机都处理掉!希望你不介意!

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch35
: Chinami {i}does{/i} mind! And she thinks big sis Chika might be overreacting right now! Chinami has nobody else to teach her about this stuff! She has to rely on {i}you{/i} for that!
lines.zh: : Chinami{i}介意{/i}!而且她觉得 Chika 姐姐现在反应过度了!除了你，没有别人能教 Chinami 这些事!她只能指望{i}你{/i}!

lines.en: : Hahah! Hahahahah! R-Right she does! But I...there are just so many pancakes I need to make and...so little time! Hahahah! {i}You saw nothing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哈哈!哈哈哈哈哈!对、对，她只能指望我!可我……还有好多煎饼要做，而且……时间又这么少!哈哈哈!{i}你什么都没看见。{/i}

lines.en: : SISTER, PLEASE!
lines.zh: : 姐姐，拜托!

lines.en: : {size=+20}NOTHING!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=+20}什么都没看见!{/size}

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch36
: You know what? On second thought, I don’t think I’ve made enough yet. I need to go make five hundred more pancakes.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？再想想，我觉得做得还不够多。我得再去做五百张煎饼。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks we don’t have enough ingredients for that...
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得我们没有那么多材料……

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch37
: Darn it! Looks like I have to run to the store then! Hahahaha-
lines.zh: : 可恶!看来我得跑一趟超市了!哈哈哈——

lines.en: : Can you take this seriously?! Chinami’s been watching you make pancakes for a full {i}hour{/i} now! She’s already eaten ten! She isn’t hungry anymore!
lines.zh: : 你能不能认真点?!Chinami 看你做煎饼整整看了{i}一个小时{/i}!她已经吃了十张了!她不饿了!

lines.en: : But you will be in the future, right? So I should just make as many as possible so you’ll be taken care of for the rest of forever!
lines.zh: : 可是你以后会饿的，对吧？所以我该尽可能多做点，好让你一辈子都有吃的!

lines.en: : You would rather give Chinami diabetes than teach her about sex?!
lines.zh: : 你宁愿让 Chinami 得糖尿病，也不肯教她性知识?!

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch38
: Good point! I should buy the {i}sugar-free{/i} pancake mix instead.
lines.zh: : 说得好!那我应该买{i}无糖{/i}的煎饼粉。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch39
: Chinami...your big sister made a mistake. She shouldn’t have done that while you were home. And she is very sorry you had to see it.
lines.zh: : Chinami……你姐姐犯了个错。她不该趁你在家的时候做那种事。她很抱歉让你看到了。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t {i}care{/i} that she saw it. She understands that big sis Chika loves Papa and that’s a thing adults do when they love each other.
lines.zh: : Chinami 并不{i}介意{/i}自己看见了。她明白 Chika 姐姐爱爸爸，而那是大人相爱时会做的事。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch40
: That’s sort of...{i}all{/i} she understands, though. And she thinks she is ready to learn more.
lines.zh: : 不过那差不多……就是她{i}全部{/i}能理解的了。而她觉得自己准备好学更多了。

lines.en: : Well...let me ask you this — why do you {i}want{/i} to learn more? Because {i}I{/i} was an early bloomer, but you’re even younger than {i}I{/i} was when mom taught me about this stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我问你——你为什么{i}想{/i}学更多？因为{i}我{/i}算是早熟的，可你比妈妈教我这些事时的{i}我{/i}还要小。

lines.en: : Are you, like...{i}noticing{/i} things about yourself? Do you {i}feel{/i} any different when you think about boys?
lines.zh: : 你有没有……比方说……{i}留意到{/i}自己身上的变化？想到男生的时候，你{i}感觉{/i}有什么不同吗?

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know any boys, so she doesn’t really think about them.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不认识什么男生，所以也不怎么想他们。

lines.en: : Does...Chinami feel different when she thinks about {i}Tsukasa?{/i} Or any of big sis Chika’s friends?
lines.zh: : 那……想到{i}Tsukasa{/i}的时候，Chinami 会有什么不同的感觉吗？或者 Chika 姐姐的朋友里任何一个?

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch41
: Not really...is she {i}supposed{/i} to?
lines.zh: : 没什么……她{i}应该{/i}有吗?

lines.en: : You’re not {i}supposed{/i} to feel anything specific. Everyone thinks about this stuff differently. It’s just...you’re a little {i}too{/i} young to be thinking about this at all.
lines.zh: : 你{i}不必{/i}非得有某种特定的感觉。每个人对这种事的想法都不一样。只是……你{i}实在{/i}还太小，根本不该想这些。

lines.en: : Did...Tsukasa put you up to this? Because I know {i}she{/i} was asking and-
lines.zh: : 是……Tsukasa 让你来问的吗？因为我知道{i}她{/i}之前就在问，而且——

lines.en: : Tsukasa didn’t put Chinami up to anything.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 没有指使 Chinami 做任何事。

lines.en: : It’s just sex, sex, sex, everywhere Chinami looks now and it’s making her head hurt.
lines.zh: : 只是现在 Chinami 不管看哪儿都是性、性、性，看得她头疼。

lines.en: : It’s scary, right?
lines.zh: : 挺吓人的吧?

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch42
: Kind of...but Chinami can’t really explain why.
lines.zh: : 有点……不过 Chinami 也说不清为什么。

lines.en: : I was the same way. Mom practically had to strap me down to teach me about the birds and the bees. I kept getting nervous and running away.
lines.zh: : 我以前也是这样。妈妈简直得把我绑起来才能教我那些「鸟儿和蜜蜂」。我老是一紧张就跑。

lines.en: : So...major props to you for just confronting me about it, I guess. You’re stronger than I was.
lines.zh: : 所以……你能直接来找我摊牌，我得给你好好鼓个掌。你比我那时候坚强。

lines.en: : I just...I don’t really know...how to approach this.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我真不知道……该怎么开口。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch43
: I’m still...kind of {i}new{/i} to a lot of this, Chinami. This whole “filling two roles” thing. And I {i}knew{/i} this day would come eventually, but...
lines.zh: : Chinami，我对很多事……还{i}很生疏{/i}。这个「一人分饰两角」的活儿。而且我{i}知道{/i}这一天迟早会来，可是……

lines.en: : As you can probably guess from all of the pancakes, I kept pushing it away every time the thought came up.
lines.zh: : 从这堆煎饼你应该也猜得到，每次这个念头冒出来，我都把它推开。

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch44
: So I’ll {i}teach{/i} you, but...
lines.zh: : 所以我{i}会{/i}教你，不过……

lines.en: : I need time to figure out {i}how{/i} first. This is a sensitive topic and I don’t want to, like...accidentally mess something up and mess {i}you{/i} up in the process.
lines.zh: : 我得先花时间想清楚{i}该怎么教{/i}。这是个敏感的话题，我不想……比方说……一不小心搞砸了，顺带把{i}你{/i}也搞砸了。

lines.en: : Is that okay? Can you give me a little time?
lines.zh: : 这样可以吗？你能给我一点时间吗?

lines.en: : Can Chinami have permission to watch pornography in the meantime?
lines.zh: : 那这段时间 Chinami 能获准看色情片吗?

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch45
: Never.
lines.zh: : 永远不行。

lines.en: : Yeah...she had a feeling you were going to say that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她就有预感你会这么说。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry again for...last night, Chinami. I’m sorry for confusing you. I just...
lines.zh: : 还有，昨晚的事我再说一次对不起，Chinami。我很抱歉让你困惑。我只是……

lines.en: : It won’t happen again, okay?
lines.zh: : 不会再发生了，好吗?

lines.en: : But then...where will you and Papa-
lines.zh: : 可是那样的话……你和爸爸以后要在——

lines.en: : That is {i}not{/i} something you should worry about. It’s not something you should even {i}think{/i} about. And it is {i}definitely{/i} not something you should talk to Papa about.
lines.zh: : 这{i}不是{/i}你该操心的事。这甚至不是你该{i}想{/i}的事。而且{i}绝对{/i}不是你该跟爸爸谈的事。

lines.en: : Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 你明白了吗?

lines.en: : Yes, big sis Chika...Chinami understands.
lines.zh: : 明白了，Chika 姐姐……Chinami 明白。

lines.en: : Good. I love you.
lines.zh: : 好。我爱你。

lines.en: : Chinami loves you too...
lines.zh: : Chinami 也爱你……

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch46
: On another note, though...what are we going to do with all of these pancakes? Because we can’t really {i}save{/i} them despite what I said in my earlier fit of anti-sex mania.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……这么多煎饼我们怎么办？因为我先前那阵反性狂热里说的那些不算数，它们其实{i}存不住{/i}。

lines.en: : Maybe Chinami can throw them off the balcony when birds come by to feed them?
lines.zh: : 也许等鸟飞过来的时候，Chinami 可以把它们从阳台上扔下去喂鸟?

lines.en: : Big sis Chika would very much like to deep clean the balcony first. And the bedroom. And the-
lines.zh: : Chika 姐姐非常想先彻底打扫一遍阳台。还有卧室。还有——

lines.en: scene chinamibalconycatch47
: Oh no.
lines.zh: : 哦不。

lines.en: : What’s wrong, big sis Chika?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Chika 姐姐?

lines.en: : Uhh........nothing!
scene black
: I just...have to clean the kitchen really quick! Don’t eat any more pancakes! No matter what!
lines.zh: : 我只是……得赶紧把厨房收拾一下!别再吃煎饼了!不管怎样都别吃!

lines.en: : Chinami thinks she’ll die if she eats another pancake, so that shouldn’t be a problem.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得再吃一张煎饼她就会死，所以这应该不成问题。

lines.en: : Also, shouldn’t big sis Chika clean that shirt too? Since that’s the one she was wearing when-
lines.zh: : 还有，Chika 姐姐是不是也该把那件衬衫洗一洗？因为那就是你当时穿的那件，在你——

lines.en: : Aaaaaaah! Go take a shower or something! I don’t want any more information on how much you saw!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊!去洗澡什么的!你到底看见了多少，我不想再听了!

lines.en: : Can Chinami ask one more question first?
lines.zh: : Chinami 能再问最后一个问题吗?

lines.en: : Mnngnhhhhgh fine! But just {i}one!{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……好吧!但就{i}一个{/i}!

lines.en: : Is it normal for them to be as big as Papa’s?
lines.zh: : 它们的尺寸跟爸爸的一样大，正常吗?

lines.en: : NEVERMIND! SHOWER! NOW!
lines.zh: : 当我没问!去洗澡!现在!

lines.en: And so one more fruit began to ripen.
lines.zh: 于是，又一颗果实开始成熟。

lines.en: How far will it fall from the tree, I wonder?
lines.zh: 它会从树上掉下多远呢，我想知道。
